confirmation_policy: All periods are known Train development history. No Valid/raw-target access, strategy change, candidate score, candidate fit, freeze, external submission, or OOS claim. Phase 1 is fixed attribution only; Phase 2 requires a new experiment ID.

trials.comparison: Describe unchanged SN1_H1 ranking quality and official portfolio accounting over the frozen selected-source × score-magnitude × VOL20 cells.

feature_definitions.selected_source: Existing SN1 contract: Low if low_state<0; else High if low_state==0 and high_state>0; else D fallback. Reconstruct from Train baseline only.
feature_definitions.score_magnitude: Near-zero iff abs(score)<1e-12; Non-near-zero iff abs(score)>=1e-12.
feature_definitions.vol20: Exact DM-20261001-02 definition: sample SD (ddof=1) of raw_return_1day - PIT beta_1day * TOPIX return over prior 20 stock observations ending t-1, with existing features.segment_keys reset and exactly 20 finite observations; no imputation.
feature_definitions.vol_quintile: Within signal date average percentile rank among finite VOL20; q=clip(ceil(5*pct)-1,0,4), V1 lowest to V5 highest.
feature_definitions.age_and_renewal: Existing fixed Train reconstruction buckets only: event_age (event_day, age_1_4, age_5_plus, no_prior_event_in_segment), sleeve_age (under_20, 20_plus, not_held), recent same-side renewal (recurrent_same_side, single_same_side, no_recent_same_side). No new thresholds.
feature_definitions.boundary_sensitivity: Reuse 1e-12 * full daily score SD * BLAKE2b(Code, digest_size=8, key=SN1-20260928) mapped to [-0.5,0.5); no perturbation search.

model: No diagnostic model is fit. Replay the unchanged annual expanding Ridge SN1_H1 route only to reproduce the saved baseline; all subgroup results are descriptive attribution.
selection_rule: Descriptive label only. SUPPORT iff High or Low selected source independently shows both pooled non-near-zero V1>V5 and near-zero V5>=V1 on RankIC and Q5-Q1 spread, and the corresponding directional ordering holds in at least 3 of 5 complete years (2011-2015). MIXED iff any pooled comparison has its preregistered direction but the paired/year-stability rule fails or RankIC and spread conflict. NOT SUPPORTED iff neither High nor Low has the paired pooled reversal. Report all values; no label authorizes a candidate within this run.
